## What value or formula is wrong?

Name the zone / modifier / formula and the current value.

## What should it be?

The corrected value or formula.

## Source

Cite your source (e.g. P99 wiki link, patch notes, in-game measurement). Since
many P99 values are community estimates, a source is required for corrections.

## Additional context

Anything else relevant — era caveats, conflicting sources, measurement method.
